prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity flat screen design concept for ROCOS HMI industrial robot teach pendant software. Full screen UI only, straight-on, no physical device, no perspective frame, no decorative marketing layout. Landscape 16:10 composition, target 1920x1200. Precise Chinese typography, clean enterprise control interface, restrained technological feel. White #FFFFFF surfaces dominate, subtle #F5F7FB blue-gray gutters, deep navy #192B45 top and left navigation, #2563EB blue primary accents, #1F2937 text, #64748B secondary text, 12px rounded cards, thin borders, barely visible shadows. No neon, no glass blur, no decorative glow. Consistent thin line icons. Top bar must show ROCOS HMI, robot name ROCOS-07, 已连接, 控制权：本机, 已使能, 手动, 安全正常, 速度 10%, 报警 0. All these are demonstration state. Add discreet subtitle 设计概念 · 示例数据. On desktop left sidebar exactly seven items in order 总览, 手动示教, 程序编程, 运行调试, IO 与设备, 监控诊断, 系统设置. Bottom separate global control strip visible, explicit 运动停止 red outline button, label 软件停止 ≠ 安全急停. Use restrained green only for semantic ready badges. Professional meticulously aligned UI, readable generous touch controls, no illegible filler text. Screen: 总览 selected. Main content title 总览 with small English DASHBOARD eyebrow. Exactly seven main cards: top row three equal-width cards 机器人状态 (white and blue collaborative robot rendered on a subtle gray floor, status 待机, 7 自由度), 关节状态 (7 rows J1-J7 with degree values and subtle bars), TCP 位姿 (six aligned X Y Z RX RY RZ values with mm and degree units, 工具 TCP_01 and 基坐标系). Second row four equal cards 最近程序 (three named .lua programs), 运行状态 (待机, 无运行程序, muted progress), IO 状态 (DI/DO labeled on/off tiles), 报警与日志 (无活动报警 and a few neutral events). Spacious information-centered layout, no large jog controls. Bottom disabled gray 运行 and 暂停 with 未选择程序 explanation, red outline 运动停止, speed 10%.

edits.prompt: Edit this ROCOS HMI Pad landscape UI concept. Preserve overall white/blue-gray palette, 4:3 aspect, two main cards, robot render, seven joint rows, collapsed auxiliary bar and global bottom controls. Make only these corrections: (1) Top global status bar must be deep navy #192B45 with readable white/pale text, like the sidebar. Reflow all status items into TWO compact rows so a 1024x768 CSS viewport can comfortably show ROCOS HMI, ROCOS-07, 已连接, 控制权：本机, 已使能, 手动, 安全正常, 速度 10%, 报警 0 and 状态详情. Alarm 0 is neutral gray/white not red danger. Keep discreet 设计概念 · 示例数据. (2) Left navigation rail icon-only, exactly seven icons in existing order; remove the Chinese labels from rail only, maintain blue selected second icon. (3) Replace 单步 segmented label with exact text 步进. (4) Left 3D card's floating tool summary must shrink to just TCP_01 and Base, removing X Y Z Rx Ry Rz values from the floating block. Real-time detailed values are available from 状态详情. Keep degree units by each joint. Fit layout within screen using reserved heights and no clipping. Do not add features or decorative gradients.
edits.changes: Navy two-row status bar, icon-only rail, step label and compact tool summary
